g.title: CRPS_QSP
g.text: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome (CRPS) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Neurogenic Inflammation · Autoimmunity · Sympatho-Afferent Coupling · Tissue Hypoxia · Central Sensitization · Cortical Reorganization · Disuse-Bone Loop · Drug PK/PD

(20 clusters · 178 nodes · 263 edges) — core structure: the state shift from the fast peripheral inflammatory nodes (reversible) → the slow central/disuse positive-feedback nodes (quasi-irreversible) = the 'therapeutic window'

g.title: cluster_neuroinflam
g.text: 3. Neurogenic Inflammation — the fast peripheral node

g.title: cluster_spinal
g.text: 10. Spinal Central Sensitization — the slow node

g.title: Immobil
g.text: (4 weeks of experimental immobilisation alone gives a similar phenotype)

g.title: DisuseState
g.text: = the slow axis of the loop

g.title: Bcell
g.text: B cell / plasma cell clonal expansion

g.title: RANKL_OPG
g.text: RANKL/OPG ratio ↑ (mediated by CGRP · SP · disuse)

g.title: PassiveTrans
g.text: patient IgG → pain phenotype reproduced in mice

g.title: IVIG_node
g.text: small positive trial (2010) / LIPS RCT negative (2017)

g.title: SympOutflow
g.text: Sympathetic outflow (locally dysregulated on the affected side)

g.title: DRG_node
g.text: Dorsal root ganglion (DRG) — the integration point

g.title: Shunt
g.text: = warm skin and deep ischaemia coexist

g.title: TrophicSkin
g.text: Skin atrophy · sweating abnormality · hair/nail changes

g.title: Tadalafil_n
g.text: Tadalafil (PDE5i) — exploratory RCT in cold CRPS

g.title: WDR
g.text: Wide dynamic range (WDR) neuron receptive field expansion

g.title: SpreadPain
g.text: Pain spread (whole affected limb · mirror/contralateral spread)

g.title: S1_shrink
g.text: S1 somatosensory map shrinks and distorts

g.title: M1_reorg
g.text: M1 motor map reorganisation · abnormal inhibition

g.title: BPD
g.text: 'it does not feel like my hand'

g.title: Avoidance
g.text: Avoidance behaviour · non-use of the affected limb

g.title: BMD_loss
g.text: Local BMD on the affected side ↓ (patchy osteopenia)

g.title: PatchyOP
g.text: Patchy bone atrophy on plain radiography

g.title: BoneScan
g.text: Increased uptake on three-phase bone scan (diagnostic adjunct)

g.title: Window
g.text: reversible if intervention is early, quasi-irreversible if delayed

g.title: PRED_PD
g.text: (effect concentrated in the early warm phenotype)

g.title: NER_PK
g.text: rapid plasma disappearance + bone binding (long residence)

g.title: IVIG_PK
g.text: IVIG PK (t1/2 ~3-4 weeks, dilution of the IgG pool)

g.title: Rehab_PD->Window
g.text: targets the loop directly even when delayed

g.title: SCS
g.text: Spinal cord stimulation (SCS) — Kemler NEJM 2000 positive

g.title: Remission
g.text: Remission rate (primary care cohorts: most improve within 1 year)
